content.headline: AI is not one app — think Secretariat, not one desk
content.body: You do not send every file to one desk. Text, image, video, documents, and research each have specialist tools. ChatGPT is one tool among many — often not the best for the job.
bullets: Writing and tone drafts → ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini
Images, video, and voice → Gemini / Midjourney, HeyGen, Runway, ElevenLabs
